price_note: ex-showroom; 27 variants live as of July 2026
value_features: wireless charging, ventilated front seats, a 10.25-inch touchscreen with Android Auto and CarPlay, six airbags standard and a rear camera

news.fact: Hyundai hiked Creta Electric prices in June 2026, with the range now stretching from ₹18.03 lakh to ₹24.70 lakh ex-showroom
The all-new third-generation Creta on the K3 platform is expected in late 2026 with a hybrid powertrain, growing from 4.3 to nearly 4.5 metres long
Creta Electric offers up to 510 km of MIDC range from its 51.4 kWh long-range battery, with a 420 km 42 kWh variant below it
